title: Make a French-style hot dog by piercing and filling the bun
instruction: Use the spike to make a hole in the end of the bun. Put the bun in the stand, then insert the sausage into the hole.
context: French-style hot dogs keep the sausage inside an unsplit roll. Start with a solid roll: create the blind passage by pressing it onto a fixed spike, then align the sausage while the stand supports the pierced roll.
setup: Calibrated bimanual YAM, tabletop Z=0.7475 m. Unbored soft wheat roll 155×54 mm, upright at (0.30, 0.20, 0.825), flat crumb face up. Fully cooked frankfurter 145×22 mm at (0.32, -0.20, 0.7585), long axis along Y. Fixed food-grade metal spike Ø25 mm, 119 mm exposed with rounded taper, tip (0.40, 0.11, 0.924) pointing down. Fixed stainless V cradle at 45° with rear stop. Seated roll centre (0.39, -0.065, 0.850), mouth toward -Y and up. Both arms ready, jaws open. Fixture cut list and coordinates in README.
scoring: 0 before piercing. Award 0.25 for a blind hole at least 100 mm deep after withdrawal. Award 0.50 once the bun rests released in the stand before insertion. Award 1.0 for at least 95 mm of sausage inside the intact bun, with both grippers clear for one second. A side exit, through-hole or entry before stand placement scores 0. Read depth at the marked spike during the press. Check sequence by video and subtract the exposed sausage length from its original length with a ruler.
reset_notes: Use a fresh, fully baked unbored soft roll each trial. Trim only the mouth end and select rolls 155 ± 5 mm long and 54 ± 3 mm wide from one batch at 18–22 °C. Use a dry fully cooked frankfurter of matching dimensions. Clean the cold spike, stand and removable pads. Restore the fixed layout.
run_limit: 1,600 policy controls at 20 Hz (80 s), fixed layout and seed 0.
fidelity: Full-size original assets. The opening starts blocked by a passive crumb plug. PhysX contact must overcome about 4 N breakaway and 3 N sliding resistance to form a passage. A 30.5 mm bore around a 25 mm spike represents local crumb give. The rigid shell omits tearing, springback and heating. Physical forces are unmeasured.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 of 1.0 in 1,600 controls (33 live inference requests). Native scripted demo: 1.0 in 1,469 controls (108 mm insertion).
